klaim.bukti: The system achieved a high coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.914 [...] The system demonstrated its highest performance for Category III (ripe) strawberries, achieving an R2 of 0.950 and the lowest MAE of 2.65 fruits.
klaim.catatan: Stroberi, ByteTrack dengan modifikasi sadar-kelas, R2 total 0,914 dan R2 kelas matang 0,950 sesuai Tabel 10 (20 video rumah kaca).

klaim.bukti: Category III (ripe) 0.950 2.65 3.37 11.63; Category II (semi-ripe) 0.752 2.70 3.16 16.25; Category I (unripe) 0.910 4.20 5.07 9.62; Total (overall) 0.914 8.55 9.63 9.52
klaim.perbaikan: the ripe class had the highest R^2 and lowest MAE (R^2=0.950, MAE 2.65 fruits), although its MAPE (11.63%) was higher than that of the unripe class (9.62%) and its RMSE (3.37) higher than that of the semi-ripe class (3.16) [ogundele2025real]
klaim.catatan: Kelas matang unggul pada R2 dan MAE, tetapi tidak pada MAPE (kelas mentah lebih rendah) dan RMSE (kelas setengah matang lebih rendah). Pernyataan 'lebih akurat daripada kelas lain' perlu dibatasi pada R2 dan MAE.

klaim.bukti: The ratio between Tracked and GT values for single view ranged from 13 % to 23 %, while multiple views consistently outperformed, ranging from 27 % to 74 %, with the highest metrics observed in the second trial.
klaim.perbaikan: Tracked/ground-truth ratio 13-23% (single-view) vs 27-74% (multiple-view) across three trials; multi-view tracking degraded by motion blur
klaim.catatan: Angka 23% dan 74% adalah nilai tertinggi dari tiga percobaan, bukan nilai tunggal; abstrak dan simpulan sumber memang hanya menyebut nilai tertinggi. Anggur, kebun komersial, video UAV (DJI Phantom 4 RTK), PointTrack, dan anotasi MOTS sesuai.

klaim.bukti: tracking using three views presented difficulties due to motion blur from UAV movement, causing the camera to lose track of the fruit, and impacting the continuity of ID numbers through frames.
klaim.catatan: Pandangan jamak melacak lebih banyak tandan (27-74% dibanding 13-23%) tetapi terganggu kabur gerak UAV; sesuai.
